examples.en: They were hoping to find buried treasure.
examples.zh: 他们希望找到埋藏的宝藏。

examples.en: A new machine has been invented.
examples.zh: 一种新机器被发明了出来。

examples.en: The machine was used to detect gold.
examples.zh: 这台机器被用来探测金子。

examples.en: The pirates used to bury gold in the cave.
examples.zh: 海盗们过去常把金子埋在山洞里。

examples.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore.
examples.zh: 这台机器被用在海岸附近的一个山洞里。

examples.en: The cave is near the seashore.
Pirates used to hide gold here.
examples.zh: 海盗们过去常在这里藏金子。

examples.en: The party searched the whole cave thoroughly.
examples.zh: 搜索队彻底搜查了整个山洞。

examples.en: The leader examined the soil near the entrance.
examples.zh: 队长检查了洞口附近的土壤。

examples.en: They found a gold coin which was almost worthless.
examples.zh: 他们找到一枚几乎不值钱的金币。

examples.en: They found nothing except an empty tin trunk.
examples.zh: 除了一个空铁皮箱，他们什么也没找到。

examples.en: Many people are confident that the machine will work.
examples.zh: 许多人相信这台机器会起作用。

examples.en: The machine may reveal something of value.
examples.zh: 这台机器可能会发现有价值的东西。

examples.en: The machine may reveal something of value.
examples.zh: 这台机器可能会发现有价值的东西。

sentences.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
sentences.zh: 寻找丢失宝藏的梦想最近几乎变成了现实。

sentences.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
sentences.zh: 大家非常兴奋，挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

sentences.en: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
sentences.zh: 他们最终找到了一枚几乎不值钱的小金币。

sentences.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
sentences.zh: 搜索队随后彻底搜查了整个山洞，但除了一个空铁皮箱外什么也没找到。

sentences.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that the machine may reveal something of value fairly soon.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信这台机器不久就会发现有价值的东西。

article.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
article.zh: 寻找丢失宝藏的梦想最近几乎变成了现实。

article.en: A new machine called The Revealer has been invented to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
article.zh: 一种叫探宝器的新机器被发明出来，用来探测埋在地下的金子。

article.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where pirates used to hide gold.
article.zh: 这台机器被用在海岸附近的一个山洞里，据说海盗们曾在那里藏金子。

article.en: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
article.zh: 一支搜索队带着这台新机器进入山洞，希望能找到埋藏的宝藏。

article.en: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
article.zh: 搜索队队长正在洞口附近检查土壤，这时机器显示地下有金子。

article.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
article.zh: 大家非常兴奋，挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

article.en: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
article.zh: 他们最终找到了一枚几乎不值钱的小金币。

article.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
article.zh: 搜索队随后彻底搜查了整个山洞，但除了一个空铁皮箱外什么也没找到。

article.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that the machine may reveal something of value fairly soon.
article.zh: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信这台机器不久就会发现有价值的东西。
